name: Hunt the Savages
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Among the more ornery of the wildlife of the Hinterlands are the savage owlbeasts. Many a good Revantusk warrior has been lost to the ferocious claws and beak of the beasts.

Kill every savage owlbeast you see, friend. Return to me when you can stand no more bloodshed. Your contribution will then be weighed, measured, and judged.
narrative.objectives:
Huntsman Markhor at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill 20 Savage Owlbeasts. Return to him once the task is complete.

Markhor mentioned that the Savage Owlbeasts occupy the wilds of the Hinterlands.
narrative.offerRewardText: You have proven a worthy ally to the Revantusk, adventurer. Well done.
narrative.requestItemsText: Clear your head of impure thoughts, friend. Become one with the wilds!
